Fit verdict: keep our direct per-epoch judge (2-3 attempts can't converge Elo); adopt Elo one level up as a persistent cross-epoch ladder over reusable strategies/prompts/notes, fed for free by judge.js pairwise verdicts and used to bias attempt-strategy selection in optimize.js. item.value: Likely referent of 'Elo in RSI' news = RoboPhD v2 (arXiv 2604.04347, Apr 2026, AWS-affiliated authors, MIT-licensed optimize_anything() toolkit): Elo tournament selection over whole agents; 22-line seed -> 1,013-line agent on ARC-AGI, 27.8%->65.8%, beats GEPA and Autoresearch on 3/4 benchmarks at 1,500-eval budget.

RoboPhD Elo mechanism: 3-agent tournaments per iteration on 20 sampled training examples; pairwise mean-accuracy = match outcome; standard Elo (init 1500, K=32); winner advances + RandomTop sampling by Elo rank; -200 Elo clone penalty for identical-prediction variants; Evolution agent (Claude Opus 4.6 via Claude Code) writes the next candidate from Elo rankings + error reports. 'Validation-free evolution' — Elo on training data is both evaluation and selection.

Other plausible matches: Elo-Evolve (arXiv 2602.13575, Feb 2026 — Elo-orchestrated opponent selection for model alignment, ~4.5x noise reduction vs absolute scoring), ART (2512.00617), Tournament of Prompts/DEEVO (2506.00178, Amazon 2025). Sakana RSI Lab and Meta HyperAgents dominate RSI press but do NOT use Elo.

Fit verdict for our loop: do NOT replace the per-epoch judge with Elo (2-3 attempts/task can't converge a rating). Adopt Elo one level up: persistent ladder over reusable strategies/prompts/knowledge notes, updated as a free by-product of judge.js pairwise verdicts (init 1500, K=32, trusted after >=10 matches), with Elo-biased strategy selection in optimize.js (champion + RandomTop).
